name: Shani Erez
biography: Shani is an Israeli actress and trained at the Royal Central School of Speech and Drama. Shani is a director, and teaches at The Royal Central School of Speech and Drama as well as BADA. Screen credits include Mrs Fineberg in The Little Drummer Girl (BBC), Ruth in Silent Witness (BBC), Ma'or in The Honourable Woman (BBC) and feature film American Assassin (CBS/Lionsgate).
